section_summary.extract_value: This section presents a confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) of the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) conducted on a second split-half subsample (n=475) from Study X. The initial one-factor model showed suboptimal fit indices, but after freeing error covariances between specific item pairs, the model achieved adequate fit with improved indices (robust CFI=.950, robust TLI=.930). The internal consistency (omega=.88) and convergent validity (AVE=.57) were both adequate.
